config.notes: Athabasca University (athabascau.ca), Canada's Open University: every programme is delivered online (Platform Admin 5 Oct 12:12); text only, no page JSON. Page kind: one programme summary page per programme, https://www.athabascau.ca/programs/summary/<programme>.html (all 50 courses bound to these on 5 Oct; 3-year BA options share the major's page, which prints 'a 3-year and a 4-year option' and 'Credits: 90 or 120'; both BGS designations share the BGS page). Intakes: undergraduate pages print 'Next start: monthly' (monthly admissions, enrol at any time) - term_months maps 'monthly' to all twelve months (taken from the course page itself); graduate pages print an 'Application deadlines and start dates' table 'deadline | start' (e.g. 'June 15, 2026 Aug. 2026', 'March 1 Sept.') - the start month after each dated deadline (pick all), 'Sept' mapped to September; MSc Information Systems prints '2 intakes each year: in Sept. and Jan.'; DBA/EdD 'classes start in <month>'. MA Interdisciplinary Studies prints terms (spring/fall/winter) with no month mapping, so it gives no months. Fee: programme pages print per-course fee tables (undergraduate 'student living outside Canada' 3-credit totals $1,737.50/$1,674.50, older than the calendar; graduate per-course fees incl. 'outside Canada' rows, MBA ESTIMATED TOTAL) - no annual figure, so no fee pattern. Current undergraduate rate (2026-27 calendar, effective Sep. 1, 2026 to Aug. 31, 2027, https://www.athabascau.ca/calendar/undergraduate/fees-refunds-and-financial-assistance/students-outside-canada.html): student living outside Canada, 3-credit course total $1,771.50 (Faculties of Business, Health Disciplines) / $1,707.50 (Humanities and Social Sciences, Science and Technology). Annual international fee = 3-credit course total x (full-time credits per year / 3); the calendar prints a full course load of 3.75 credits per month (part-time-full-time-students.html) and programme pages print e.g. 120 credits in 4 years of full-time study; estimated-program-fees.html prints the outside-Canada totals per credit count (30 credits $17,715 / $17,075; 45 credits $26,572.50 / $25,612.50). Needs a rate x credits mechanism and a decision on the annual load (reported 5 Oct). Duration = 'Finish this program in as little as ...'; study_level = 'Credential: ...'. English: no IELTS on pages; central rule IELTS 6.0 overall (approved central English policy). Delivery (mode): page title segment holding 'online' (e.g. '| Online degree |'), else 'N-credit online degree program', 'online and on your own time', or the page's 'first step to online learning' panel. Central calendars attached 5 Oct: 2026-2027 undergraduate and graduate calendars (https://www.athabascau.ca/calendar/undergraduate/index.html, https://www.athabascau.ca/calendar/graduate/index.html) and the undergraduate fees and registration sections. (Claude bespoke adapter, 5 Oct)
